descriptions.value: Insecure permissions in the feiertage.ImportActivity component of Arbeitszeiterfassung2 versionCode 159 allows unauthorized attackers to create forged holiday/work-time entries via crafted ICS imports.

A OS command injection vulnerability exists in the boa formMapDelDevice macstr functionality of X2000R (version(s): TOTOLINK-X2000R-Gh-V1.0.0-B20250421.1327). A specially crafted HTTP request can lead to arbitrary code execution. An attacker can make an authenticated HTTP request to trigger this vulnerability.

descriptions.description: CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
